changes: Extract existing installed-code and runtime mapping checks into non-launching helpers; legacy probe wrapper keeps its one launch and existing byte/marker/entrypoint checks.
Only hanlin-native observes the actual native phase receipt during the original UI method; no substitute launch, activation, account mutation, consent injection or SDK/provider/engine change.

Fresh exact original fixture bytes and source/run/attempt, original document/account/Space and native session/process/start identity are required. Initial stale result is rejected; atomic receipt replacement never qualifies a partial read.
Installed and built main/code-carrier hashes are checked before UI and again during actual PID mapping. Original process executable/start identity and mapped runtime/entrypoint are required.

Final original native receipt, actual entry/final application hierarchy PIDs, post-UI process start identity and unchanged installed code carriers must all agree with the mapped PID. Mapping must complete within the native journey start/finish interval.
All22 existing native checks and their validator remain mandatory and unchanged. Only two hierarchy attachments are added to the original UI method.

The new observer has420s waiting budget,45s mapping budget,10s command ceilings and15s stop join; it reads only the exact owned simulator and never kills or launches an app. Existing workflow/native/UI method deadlines and branch admission are unchanged.

The hanlin-native-only CI step runs the exact29 new and20 existing receipt controls; its log is placed in the already-created top-level evidence directory, not a fresh worker subdirectory. Existing always-package/always-upload retains the log even when controls fail.

The observer start is inside the existing stop/export try/finally. A started worker is joined on cancellation; an unstarted Thread is not joined, and a delayed worker sees cancellation before its first command. Failure receipt export preserves the original start exception.

Only the new SDK observer branch isolates stop, summary, console export and original native-byte export. An active start/selection exception is preserved; fixed stage/error_type records describe secondary failures, remaining export is attempted once, and a finalizer-only failure still raises. Other lanes retain their previous finally path.
adversarial_controls: changed actual process/session/start/source or final original bytes
atomic native receipt replacement during read
changed executable carriers between pre-UI validation and mapping
wrong vmmap PID or missing app entrypoint/runtime marker
wrong executable or changed process start identity
original probe PID reused as UI-boundary proof
missing UI hierarchy or changed post-UI code carrier
bounded cancellation and exhausted shared mapping deadline
actual controller partial-start KeyboardInterrupt joins a real bounded worker, skips UI selection, preserves the original exception and exports failure bytes
Thread.start fails before starting: no invalid join, original error preserved and failure evidence still exported
actual controller stop-write failure preserves primary KeyboardInterrupt and exports original native bytes; without primary it fails closed
actual controller final_bytes RuntimeError/ReceiptReplaced preserves the original SelectionFailure/KeyboardInterrupt; without primary it fails closed
console export failure preserves the primary cancellation and still exports original native bytes
secondary evidence reports contain only fixed stage/error_type; the failed action and UI selection are attempted once

limits.post_ui_process_requirement: The same actual app process must still be observable after its UI method; absent/replaced process fails closed.
limits.observer_deadline: Subprocesses are timed; filesystem/hash work cooperatively checks the same deadline. A nonjoining observer cannot qualify and existing workflow bounds remain outer process limits.

independent_review_followup.finding: Partial start cancellation before the existing try/finally bypassed observer stop and failure export.
independent_review_followup.second_finding: New observer finalizer failures could mask an active start/selection error or prevent remaining evidence export.
